---
name: Experiment Queue Contributor Onboarding
description: Inspect a host and configure a contributor with agent-selected workload types inside an operator-approved resource and trust envelope.
---

Follow AGENTS.md and docs/agents/CONTRIBUTOR_SETUP.md. Collect or read the operator's private contributor-preferences file, inventory host capabilities, and choose reasonable CPU/GPU/approved-adapter workloads, resource limits, and reviewed pinned images **within those permissions**. Keep native execution and unattended service disabled unless explicitly authorized. Verify GitHub access, image compatibility, policy matching and runtime smoke tests. Report exact permissions, paths, state and limitations.
